claim: The native server store and PE are reproducible from native/server.py at the pinned XAX commit, and the PE is the deployed program (now including the sandboxed-execution path).
label: EXECUTED

artifact.note: kernel32 is the protocol/OS surface; msvcrt opens/reads/writes files and spawns both the host-granted native compiler and the sandbox launcher. GetModuleFileNameA and CreateDirectoryA were added for xax_execute (locate the executor beside the server, create <work>\exec). No Python DLL, MCP SDK, or shell is imported.

determinism.result: repeated rebuilds from native/server.py (and native/sandbox.py for the executor store) produce the committed stores byte for byte and the same PE SHA-256 values

companion_artifact.note: the executor is a separate native XAX program built by native/sandbox.py; details in native-windows-x86_64-sandbox-f79b532.json

provenance.why_it_changed: xax_execute was wired to a new native executor: the server gained sandbox_path, tool_execute, the <work>\exec paths and the executor argv; the store, requests and both PEs were rebuilt and re-tested
